name: threadtruth-studio
description: Caiguang — AI Fashion Studio for real garment and coordinated-outfit photos

interface.shortDescription: AI Fashion Studio for real garment photos
interface.longDescription: Create source-faithful garment imagery for product display, styled editorials and artistic campaigns. Choose among 36 visual entries, compare directions or specify a primary and supporting style. Plan poses from the actual garment, purpose and available views. Review a labeled nine-panel direction preview before nine independent images with first-image model review; explicit six-image and classic-six choices remain available. Explicit single-image and prompt-only requests remain available. Visual validation is scoped to documented cases.
defaultPrompt: Use $threadtruth-studio to inspect my real garment photos, let me choose a style, then plan garment-appropriate poses and prepare a nine-panel direction preview before nine independent images. Preserve my explicit single, six-image or classic-six choices. Wait for the applicable generation approval; use the single-image branch only if I ask for it.
